title: Matsayi, cak da raba daidai na kuɗin ƙungiyar
course_title: Haɗin kai & Gudanar da Kasuwancin Rukuni

say: Matsayi, cak, da daidaitaccen rabon kuɗin ƙungiyar.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don tsari na biyu na Haɗin gwiwa da Gudanarwar Kasuwancin Rukuni.

A cikin ƙungiyoyi da yawa, ayyuka masu mahimmanci na kowa ne, wanda ke nufin babu kowa. Ko kuma wani memba mai kuzari ya ɗauki oda, ya karɓi ajiya, siyan kayan kuma ya adana bayanan shi kaɗai. Ko da ta kasance mai gaskiya, kungiyar ba za ta iya ganin abin da ya faru ba, kuma zato ya karu.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Aikin kowa ba aikin kowa bane

say: Rarraba ayyuka yana gyara wannan. Kowane tsarin kudi yana raba tsakanin akalla mutane biyu, don haka kuskuren daya zai iya lura da shi ta wani.
Ba zargi ba ne. Yana kare ma'ajin gaskiya, domin bayanan sun nuna abin da ya faru.

say: A cikin wannan tsarin kuma kuna bincika inganci da asusun banki kowane wata, kuma ku raba rarar daidai.

panel.rule: Kuɗin abokin ciniki baya shiga cikin asusun sirri.

say: Idan ƙungiyarku tana dafa abinci ko sarrafa abinci, ƙara tsafta zuwa SOP. Waɗannan suna bin Maɓallai biyar na WHO don Amintaccen Abinci. A wanke hannu da sabulu da ruwa mai tsafta. Rarrabe danyen abinci da dafaffe. Dafa abinci sosai, kuma a ajiye abinci a yanayin zafi mai aminci.
Kada memba mai gudawa ko amai ya rike abinci a ranar.

say: Mai siye yana tsammanin inganci iri ɗaya duk wanda ya yi abun. Don haka rubuta takardar ƙayyadaddun bayanai a sarari yadda mambobi biyu masu duba abu ɗaya suka kai ga yanke hukunci ɗaya. Sa'an nan duba kowane batch da rikodin sakamakon.
Kar a taɓa sukar aiki mara ƙarfi a bainar jama'a akan WhatsApp.

Misali, Grace a Jos ta samu littafin a kan kudi naira 412,500, bankin kuma ya samu 389,000. Da farko dai, an bace kudaden banki da na SMS na naira 1,500.

Idan har yanzu kudi ba a nan, kar a zargi kowa a cikin tattaunawar rukuni. Kwamitin kulawa yana tambaya a asirce kuma yana ba da rahoto ga babban taron.

say: Yanzu farashin oda. Ayyukan membobin kuɗi ne na gaske. Idan farashin kawai ya rufe kayan, membobin suna aiki ba tare da komai ba.

Odar ya kai Naira 1,950,000. Kayayyakin sun kai 855,000, kuma aikin dinki da ake biya ga mambobi shine 450,000. Tare da yankan, sufuri, man fetur da kuma kuɗin banki, jimillar kuɗin ya kai naira 1,470,000.
